meta.title: OpenAEC Launch Day — 15 December 2026, Dordrecht
meta.description: The official launch of the OpenAEC Foundation on Tuesday 15 December 2026 in Dordrecht, the Netherlands, from 16:00 to 20:00. Live demos, a panel and a walking dinner. Free, registration required.

header.label: Events · launch
header.desc: The OpenAEC Foundation officially gets under way. See live what open-source software for construction can already do, talk to the people who build it and stay for dinner.

program.title: Programme
program.r1: Doors open, coffee and demo tables
program.r2: Opening: why construction needs open source
program.r3: Keynote: how Open CAD Studio is being built (in English)
program.r4: Live: from drawing to BIM model, fully open source
program.r5: Panel: what does open source mean for your company?
program.r6: The First Pile: the OpenAEC Foundation officially gets under way
program.r7: Walking dinner, demo market and networking
program.note: We will announce the speakers and the exact venue in Dordrecht soon. The event is mainly in Dutch, with parts in English.

who.title: Who is it for
who.p: For everyone in construction who works with software and wants to know what open source can mean for their company:
who.li1: directors and owners of engineering and architecture firms, contractors and installers
who.li2: BIM managers, BIM coordinators and heads of engineering
who.li3: developers and students who want to contribute

form.title: Register
form.intro: Attendance is free. Places are limited, so please register in advance.
form.consent: The OpenAEC Foundation may use my details to process this registration and to inform me about the Launch Day.
form.ok: Thank you, we have received your registration. You will hear from us, and a few days before 15 December we will send the practical details.
form.mail: Your email program opens with your registration already filled in. Send that email to complete your registration; it goes to info@open-aec.com.
form.invalid: Please fill in the required fields and give permission to use your details.
form.privacy: We only use your details for this event and do not share them with anyone. You can always unsubscribe or have your details deleted via info@open-aec.com.
